alternatives_rejected.why: Injected delay would not drive CPU up by 655% (z=67.44, E1). Own-span self-time rising 2.48x (E2) fits slower compute from CPU saturation.

Frontend's deviation is minor (latency-50 z=5.89, 29.5%) compared with recommendationservice (latency-90 z=173.44, E1). That fits frontend latency being propagated from a slow downstream call (E2 inbound self-time 1.4x), not originating there.

proposed_fix.description: Find the CPU hog in recommendationservice, such as a runaway process or a stress workload. Stop it if it is extraneous. Meanwhile, temporarily scale out replicas or raise CPU limits to restore latency. Confirm that CPU and latency-90 return to baseline.
